intro.summary: Small northwest community of mostly single-detached homes on the hill beside Foothills Medical Centre, where new builds tend to replace one house with one house.
intro.body: St. Andrews Heights is a small, mostly single-detached community on the hill next to Foothills Medical Centre. It has almost no semi-detached housing. Redevelopment here usually means a new single-detached home replacing an older one on the same lot, not a lot split.
